name: PHPRunner
tagline: Build database-driven web applications with forms, reports and permissions.
description:
PHPRunner is a desktop application builder for developers creating internal tools and web portals around databases. The authoring application supports macOS, Windows and Linux; end users access the resulting applications in a browser.

Features include data-entry pages, search, reports, charts, dashboards and user permissions. Events and custom code handle application-specific behavior. Deployment and database administration remain the operator's responsibility.

Applications run on the customer's own web server with a compatible PHP runtime and database extensions. Microsoft Access deployments require a Windows server. The official download page lists macOS without a minimum release or hardware requirement; no native Apple Silicon claim is made. The preview image shows the Windows interface, not the Mac version.

PHPRunner offers optional AI-assisted development. Do not assume AI-assisted features process data entirely on-device; review the current product documentation and applicable privacy terms for the intended workflow.

PHPRunner is commercial, closed-source software. Professional Edition is US$599 per developer, including one year of email support and upgrades. The evaluation lasts 21 days.
pricingDetails: Professional US$599 per developer; includes one year of email support and upgrades. A 21-day evaluation is available.
